title: PR body misdescribes the terminal_types golden as 'fixture + one small_biz + one campus'; the demo actually uses fixture off with six explicit spawns
evidence: PR body: "New `demos/terminal_types.dem` (era 3, growth on, fixture + one small_biz + one campus)". Actual demo lines: `fixture off` / `spawn_node router_mid 20 15` / `spawn_node residential 8 15` / `spawn_node content_host 32 15` / `spawn_node residential 14 22` / `spawn_node residential 26 22` / `spawn_node small_biz 12 10` / `spawn_node campus 30 10`. Demo comment (line 3-5): "`fixture off` + explicit spawn_node directives lay out the spectrum (run setup — re-created identically on every replay, like the fixture; era gating is a GROWTH rule, spawn_node is explicit)".
detail: Round-2 mandate audits re-bless cause documentation. The golden demo has no standard fixture — it spawns a router_mid hub plus three homes, a host, one small_biz, one campus. PR wording misstates the mechanism.
recommended_fix: Amend the PR body to say 'fixture off + explicit spawn_node layout (3 homes, 1 host, 1 small_biz, 1 campus on a mid-router hub)'. The demo itself is correct and self-documenting.
